title: 第9章 深夜要田契各怀心思第10章 小吉 山鸡窝
slug: 乱世荒年我每日一卦粮肉满仓
content_zh:
第9章深夜要田契？各怀心思
饭后各自回房。
躺在床上的陈巧翠轻声问：“他爹，小尘好像真的变了一点啊。”
虽然说，还是霸占了陶盆，还是挑剔娇惯……
但起码将兔子带回了，他们也吃到肉了。
江田的声音比早上有底气多了：“当然变了，以前他要是捡到兔子，肯定拿去卖了，今天舍得拿回来，这还不算变？”
“你没看见他分肉的时候，爹都擦眼睛了。”
陈巧翠叹了口气：“是变了，变得太突然，我反倒有点怕。”
“怕什么？”
陈巧翠索性坐了起来：“你说老二会不会想把爹哄开心了，回头就去要田契？现在家里值钱的就剩那几块田了。”
家里的田，都是江有林当年当兵、打猎拼下来的，田契还都在他手上。
江田皱了皱眉：“瞎说什么？小尘不是这种人。”
“就是！”
江晓芸从被子里探出头：“二叔是好人，肯定不会这么干！”
陈巧翠没好气地说：“死丫头，一只兔腿就把你收买了！”
“我说，你要不去看看？”
陈巧翠捅了捅郎君：“爹要是真糊涂了，你也好劝两句。”
“劝什么？那都是爹的田，就算给了小尘，我能说什么，睡觉！”
“可是……”
陈巧翠还想说什么，旁边已传出江田的鼾声。

她也只能气呼呼地躺下。
这时，隔壁江尘轻轻推开房门，走进了江有林的房间，喊了一声：“爹！”
“唉……”
江有林的叹息声在黑暗中响起，带着几分复杂的意味。
看着江尘走过来，从床上坐起，用火折子小心点亮了灯草。
又从枕头下面取出了一沓纸：“这就是家里的田契。”
说话时，抽走了其中的一张：“给你哥哥嫂子留两亩，其他的你就拿去吧。”
“趁早去，跟陈花好好说说，我看那姑娘也挺看中你的，哄一哄就好了。”
江尘看着老爹眼角沁出的泪光，一时有些发愣。
什么意思？
直接把田契给自己去哄陈花？让自己去当舔狗？
穿越前没当舔狗，穿越后反倒要当舔狗。
那他不是白穿越了吗！
世间哪有这样的道理！
当即把江有林手中的田契全拿了过去，顺手又塞回了枕头里：“爹，你想什么呢！”
“我不是来要田契的，我是想学学怎么布陷阱，就能抓兔子的那种。”
江有林本来见江尘抢过所有田契，表情有些绝望，心里已经在想明天该怎么跟老大解释。
content_en:
Chapter 9: Asking for the land deed late at night? Everyone has their own thoughts
After dinner, everyone went back to their rooms.
Chen Qiaocui, who was lying on the bed, asked softly: "Dad, Xiaochen seems to have really changed a bit."
Although he still occupied the pottery basin, he was still picky and pampered...
But at least they brought the rabbit back and they got some meat.
Jiang Tian's voice was more confident than in the morning: "Of course it has changed. If he picked up a rabbit before, he would definitely sell it. Today he is willing to take it back. Doesn't this count as a change?"
"Didn't you see that dad wiped his eyes when he was dividing the meat?"
Chen Qiaocui sighed: "It has changed. It has changed so suddenly that I am a little scared."
"What are you afraid of?"
Chen Qiaocui simply sat up: "Do you think the second son wants to make dad happy and ask for the land deed later? Now the only valuable fields in the family are those."
The fields at home were all obtained by Jiang Youlin as a soldier and hunter, and the deeds to the fields are still in his hands.
Jiangtian frowned: "What nonsense are you talking about? Xiaochen is not this kind of person."
"That's right!"
Jiang Xiaoyun poked her head out from under the quilt: "Second uncle is a good person and will definitely not do this!"
Chen Qiaocui said angrily: "Damn girl, I bought you with a rabbit leg!"
"I said, why don't you go and take a look?"
Chen Qiaocui poked her husband and said, "If dad is really confused, you might as well give him some advice."
"What are you advising me to do? That's all my father's land. Even if it's given to Xiaochen, what can I say? Go to sleep!"
"But..."
Chen Qiaocui wanted to say something else, but Jiang Tian's snoring could be heard next to him.
She could only lie down angrily.
At this time, Jiang Chen next door gently opened the door, walked into Jiang Youlin's room, and shouted: "Dad!"
"Alas..."
Jiang Youlin's sigh sounded in the darkness, with a somewhat complicated meaning.
Watching Jiang Chen come over, he sat up from the bed and carefully lit the lamp grass with a fire stick.
Then he took out a pile of paper from under the pillow: "This is the land deed at home."
As he spoke, he took one of the cards away: "Leave two acres for your brother and sister-in-law, and you can take the rest."
"Go as soon as possible and have a good talk with Chen Hua. I think that girl is also very fond of you. Just give her some coaxing."
Jiang Chen looked at the tears in his father's eyes and was a little dazed for a moment.
What's the meaning?
Just give him the Tian Deed to coax Chen Hua? Let yourself be a bitch?
I didn’t act like a licking dog before I traveled through time, but I became a licking dog after traveling through time.
Then didn’t he travel through time in vain?
There is no such truth in the world!
He immediately took all the Tian deeds from Jiang Youlin's hand and stuffed them back into the pillow: "Dad, what are you thinking about!"
"I'm not here to ask for the land deed. I just want to learn how to set traps so that I can catch rabbits."
Jiang Youlin had a desperate expression when he saw Jiang Chen grabbing all the land deeds. He was already thinking about how to explain to the boss tomorrow.
